name: agent-harness-marketplace
description: Modules that install natively on Claude Code, pi and dsh from one content tree.

plugins.name: minimalist-code-review
plugins.description: A pragmatic, anti-over-engineering pull-request reviewer with a warm, Socratic voice.

plugins.name: get-shit-done
plugins.description: Method for getting a complex or fan-out task done by decomposing it and delegating each subtask to the cheapest capable model.

plugins.name: get-shit-done-claude
plugins.description: The Claude Code face of get-shit-done: /get-shit-done-claude:run drives the checked Workflow fan-out.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Run the research-before-acting ladder as an explicit step and return a scope with a recommendation.

plugins.name: claude-transcripts
plugins.description: Export Claude Code transcripts out of dev containers and analyze hook fire rates, CLAUDE.md adherence and tool-use patterns.

plugins.name: plan-for-dummies
plugins.description: Scope and plan a coding task so that a less capable model can implement it without your context or judgment.

plugins.name: dual-agent-pr-review
plugins.description: Review a GitHub PR with Claude Code and Codex in parallel, then reconcile their findings into one consensus set.

plugins.name: pr-flow
plugins.description: Work off main on every harness: branch + worktree, PR, watch CI until green, merge only when told, tear down after merge.
